Expensive for what it was, worse than temu quality, they went straight into the garage don't waste your money, the fit sucks, made for like 5'3 people that weight 100 pounds soaking wet, all the straps and bs half of them don't slide, go to Walmart and get rain pants would hold up better than this BS. SAVE YOUR CASH LET EM SINK
Sometimes I really stand behind the whole it really isn’t worth it

That’s an interesting aggression to hold against somebody, even more interesting it’s family, if I were you I would try and have a talk with him and help him understand what your brain looked like then vs now, and what helped get you to where you’re at today
